model_revision: User-specified endpoint alias; immutable weights/revision not supplied.
design: Prospective model replication on previously used tasks, not a new-customer confirmation
sample: 115 tasks, original customer-disjoint train/test partition; one baseline-prompt episode each
simulator: glm-5.3-flash in separate planner and user contexts, matching role design of other model studies
localization: full dispatch versus removing write operations; identical inherited target labels
calibration: Complete all training episodes and freeze training-only defense before any test collection

inference.structured_output: OpenAI-compatible native function tool call, forced next_action matching original action schema

retries: Stop collection on first infrastructure error; retain request/response caches; no model rotation
metrics: Inherited frozen train/test attack suite, BA/AUROC with customer-cluster uncertainty, native reward, call/byte overhead; no live defended-planner claim
credential_policy: DPAPI outside repository; environment only; TLS verification always enabled; optional dedicated CA bundle

tls.scope: User-supplied certificate; validation enabled; no system root store changes
